device_procedure_after_implementation_ga: Use a physical Android device with a test account and notification permission initially unset.
Authenticate, complete profile and verify personalized Radar values are truthful before enabling notifications.
Enable notifications and record OS permission result; denial must be visibly non-success.
With permission granted, create/obtain one unread high-match alert for the same tenant and prove another tenant cannot receive/read it.
Background/close the app, deliver a real push, record receipt, tap it and verify navigation to the exact current opportunity without cross-tenant leakage.
Return to Radar and verify refreshed current truth rather than stale/zero fabrication.
Force-stop/restart the app and verify authenticated session/cache continuity and honest unavailable-state handling.
Record exact app build, API deployment SHA, device/OS, account, event id, push id and screenshots/log evidence.
